summary: Jaguar Health filed a 424B5 (Supplement No. 8) updating its at-the-market (ATM) equity program, a routine shelf takedown rather than a special situation. The supplement resets the remaining capacity under General Instruction I.B.6 of Form S-3 to approximately $9,824,188, after roughly $4,899,873 of shares were sold in the trailing 12 months. Ladenburg Thalmann acts as sole sales agent following Lucid Capital Markets' December 31, 2025 expiry. Non-affiliate float was about $44.2 million across 1,281,839 shares at $34.46 (September 22 close); JAGX last traded $8.91. Watch dilution and Nasdaq compliance.
